why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to "SSYS by the Sea." A refined WaterColor sanctuary professionally curated and managed by Stay on 30A. This impeccably designed four-bedroom retreat blends elevated coastal luxury with the relaxed sophistication that defines 30A living. Every detail from the warm, organic textures to the sun-filled gathering spaces has been intentionally crafted to create an atmosphere of ease, comfort, and understated elegance. Inside, an open and airy layout invites connection. The chef-inspired kitchen flows seamlessly into the stylish dining area and spacious living room, offering the ideal setting for shared meals, long conversations, and effortless unwinding after a day along the Gulf. Each bedroom is thoughtfully appointed to provide a serene, hotel-level experience, ensuring every guest feels indulged and completely at home. Step outdoors and discover your private oasis. Begin your mornings with a peaceful swim, spend afternoons basking in the 30A sunshine, or unwind in the evenings on the expansive porches wrapped in the warm coastal breeze. With complimentary adult bikes included in your stay, exploring WaterColor becomes second nature. Cruise to Camp WaterColor, visit the Beach Club, or meander along nature trails and charming pathways with ease. Perfectly positioned for both relaxation and adventure,  SSYS by the Sea  is a thoughtfully curated escape designed for guests who appreciate refined comfort and unforgettable moments. Whether your days are spent poolside or discovering the beauty of 30A, this home offers a luxury coastal experience you’ll want to return to year after year. **The home does not include a golf cart until March 1st.**

Whether your days are spent poolside or discovering the beauty of 30A, this home offers a luxury coastal experience you’ll want to return to year after year. **The home does not include a golf cart until March 1st.** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: WaterColor Beach Club & Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 10) Private Pool *Pool heating available for an additional fee/$50* Poolside Sun Loungers Outdoor Gas Grill Golf Cart 4 Adult Bikes Multiple Screened-In Balconies & Porch Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen Smart TVs Indoor Fireplace Full Sized Washer & Dryer Beach Essentials 6 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access Pickle Ball & Tennis Courts Short Walk to Seaside (Restaurants, Coffee Shops, Ice Cream, Wine + Cheese, Etc.) Close to Grayton State Park & Access to the Coastal Dune Lakes (Great for Kayaking & Yolo Boarding) Close Access to Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining Easy Access to Parks & Walking Paths Nearby State Parks & Preserves Parking for 3 Vehicles ACCOMMODATIONS: FIRST FLOOR: Bedroom #1: King with Ensuite SECOND FLOOR: Bedroom #2: King with Ensuite Bedroom #3: (2) Full/Full Bunks Ensuite Bedroom #4: King with Ensuite  PRIVATE BEACH & RESORT ACCESS -The WaterColor Beach Club is the only beachfront clubhouse pool available to rental guests along 30A. It is the ultimate amenity with three pools, expanded seating on upper and lower decks, and lounge areas. The Beach Club has several food and beverage options onsite, towel service, and a charming mercantile with sundries for your pool day. With unobstructed and panoramic views of the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, relaxation and pleasure await you at the Beach Club. Visit the WaterColor Beach Club page for facility hours, lounge chair etiquette, restaurant information, and rules. Wristbands must be worn by guests ages 5 and older. You can access the beach by walking through the Beach Club, and for those who want to sit on the sand, you can set up chairs and umbrellas behind the reserved chair area, or rent your own chairs and umbrellas from the rental shack.  NEARBY  PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS -Ray's Multi Mountain Beach Access: Is in the heart of Grayton Beach in "New Grayton", just to the west of the main Grayton Beach drive-on access at Hotz Avenue and the main "Grayton Dunes" access behind The Red Bar. -Grayton Dunes Beach Access: Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Three parking spaces available (3 driveway). No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only. 4 adult bikes for your convenience. GUEST ACCESS The WaterColor community is the most desirable community on 30A due to its exceptional community amenities. Guests will have inclusive access to the gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club and new Camp WaterColor facilities, in addition to other beautiful swimming pools located throughout the community. The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an adults only pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf! Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for younger kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground. OTHER THINGS TO NOTE Beach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance. Per Watercolor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands max.  In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your group upon booking, which you will receive a prompted email prior to your arrival. The HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here. The WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost. Watercolor requires guest contact information for Watercolor wristband registration a minimum of 1 week prior to arrival. Regarding the WaterColor pools, until water temperatures are consistently warm enough on their own, WaterColor's pools are maintained around 82 degrees. A $500 deposit is held at the time of golf cart rental and will be refunded at checkout, pending inspection for any damage. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *This home is allotted 10 wristbands max per HOA. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events. *No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Must be heated for duration of stay.  If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. *This home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".
